notes.held_out: Selection uses the other worlds of the suite; V is from the held-out world. Worlds are not independent: the three SmolVLM cycles split one search run, the qwen-compression chains are synthesized from a grid study, and the synthetic worlds are hand-made. Development worlds are excluded.
notes.in_sample: Selection and reported V use the same worlds.
notes.score: Eq. (1) replay score V; not LIBERO success.
notes.stage2_world: Committed 10-trial smoke measurements with the grid's parent->child edges; 'derived' bytes are a linear extrapolation, not a measurement.
